evidence.decision: Chooses immediate content from brief versus extended handheld use, comfortable touch reach, interruption/resumption and a justified system entrypoint.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a revised iPhone screen/flow or implementation with orientation, text-size and interruption acceptance checks.
evidence.transformation: Parcel desktop table/menu search becomes active-delivery status and pickup-code action, with history nearby and widget deep-link to the parcel.
evidence.verification: Checks action reachability, custom Back conflicts and restored draft/context; distinguishes static screenshots from touch/system-integration execution.
evidence.applicability: Preserves phone navigation and existing stack; accessory/voice/data integrations depend on task benefit rather than being unconditional additions.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Layout for environmental adaptation, Gestures only for custom input and Widgets only for the chosen glance.
evidence.distinctiveness: Handheld reach, interrupted tasks and contextual system entrypoints determine the actual screen hierarchy.
